blocks.content:
The mode menu switches how the chat behaves. Choose on purpose:

- **Assistant:** Do work. Ask for queries, resources, or changes and move quickly.
- **Learn:** Get step-by-step coaching. Lessons pause and ask before creating or changing anything.

Learn suggests lessons from your role, the products you care about, and services in your environment. In this milestone you open Learn, optionally start a short lesson, then switch back. Completing a full lesson is optional.

whenTrue.content: If this guide is docked in the sidebar, pop it out into a floating window so it stays visible beside **Assistant**.

blocks.content: To find Learn mode, complete the following steps:
Open **Assistant** from the top toolbar (sparkle icon) if the panel is closed.
blocks.hint: Skip if Assistant is already open from the previous milestone.

blocks.content:
At the bottom of the Assistant chat, click the mode button (it shows the current mode name, for example **Assistant**).

In the dropdown, select **Learn**. The mode button label should change to **Learn**.

Optionally paste or type a goal so Learn can suggest a lesson:

> I'm new to Grafana. Show me a short lesson on finding dashboards.

Or:

> I'm an SRE. Teach me how to use metrics, logs, and traces to look into latency for a service in my stack.

Skip this step if you only wanted to find where Learn mode lives.
Click **Send** if you entered a goal.

If Learn suggests lessons, pick one and take a single step.

Notice that Learn pauses and asks before it creates or changes anything. That is the cue to stay in Learn when you want coaching, and to switch back to **Assistant** when you want to do the work yourself. You do not need to finish the whole lesson for this path.

When you are done exploring, click the mode button again (it should say **Learn**).

In the dropdown, select **Assistant** (or another mode you use). Return to Learn when you want guided lessons; stay in Assistant for day-to-day prompts.

You can find Learn mode and choose when to use it versus Assistant: Learn for coaching that asks before changes; Assistant when you are ready to act.

For full details, refer to [Use Learn mode](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/learn-mode/).

whenTrue.content: Dock this guide back to the sidebar when you are ready for the next milestone.

blocks.content: In the next milestone, you'll wrap up this path and see where to go next.
